pseudo_labeling.summary: A network learns from the labelled bars and from its own hard predictions on unlabelled bars, weighted in slowly (Lee 2013).
pseudo_labeling.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the sigmoid of one network trained on labelled bars plus its own hard predictions on unlabelled bars, weighted in linearly. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. No price model (a regressor pseudo-labelling itself gets no gradient). Expect: near the plain network; on weak labels it confirms its own mistakes.

learning_rate.description: AdamW step size (cosine decay to a tenth).

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: Passes over the labelled rows; the best validation epoch is kept.

patience.label: Patience
patience.description: Epochs without a better validation score before stopping.

labeled_fraction.description: Share of the training span's label blocks whose labels are kept; the rest form the unlabelled pool.

unlabeled_weight.description: Full weight of the pseudo-label loss (alpha_f).

consistency_regularization.summary: Predictions must agree under input noise and dropout, against a second pass (Pi-model) or an averaged teacher network (Mean Teacher).
consistency_regularization.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from the Mean Teacher's averaged network (or the Pi-model's own); the consistency is the squared gap between two noisy predictions on every span bar. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. Augmentation is Gaussian noise plus dropout, not time warping. Expect: a smoother, slightly better calibrated plain network.

fixmatch.summary: A confident prediction on a lightly perturbed unlabelled bar becomes the target for a heavily perturbed copy of it (Sohn et al. 2020).
fixmatch.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from one network; a confident weak-view prediction is the hard target of a strong view (noise, masked features, scaled row). Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. Tabular noise replaces RandAugment; the price model keeps low-spread Monte-Carlo dropout guesses. Expect: few bars pass the threshold.

mixmatch.summary: Guessed and sharpened labels for unlabelled bars, then MixUp across labelled and unlabelled bars (Berthelot et al. 2019).
mixmatch.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from one network; unlabelled guesses average noisy copies and are sharpened, then labelled and unlabelled rows are mixed with MixUp. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. MixUp of feature rows is a regulariser with no market meaning. Expect: a regularised plain network.

virtual_adversarial_training.summary: The prediction must not change under the small perturbation of the bar's features that would change it most (Miyato et al. 2018).
virtual_adversarial_training.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from one network; for every span bar a power iteration finds the direction that moves P(up) most, and the divergence at that radius is penalised. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. The radius is in standardised feature units and can reach values a feature never takes. Expect: a smoother plain network.

entropy_minimization.summary: A network is pushed to be confident on unlabelled bars, moving its boundary into sparse regions of feature space (Grandvalet and Bengio 2005).
entropy_minimization.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from one network trained with binary cross-entropy on labelled bars plus the mean entropy of P(up) on unlabelled bars. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. No price model (the entropy of a real value is undefined). Expect: sharper, not better, probabilities; on weak signal it pushes P(up) to 0 or 1.

ladder_network.summary: A clean and a noisy encoder with a denoising decoder: every layer of the noisy path is reconstructed from the layer above (Rasmus et al. 2015).
ladder_network.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) from the clean encoder with running batch statistics; training adds the per-layer denoising cost of the noisy path on every span bar. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. A small multilayer ladder over the feature row, no convolutions. Expect: close to a batch-normalised plain network.

semi_supervised_vae.summary: A variational autoencoder that generates the bar's features from a latent code and the up / down label, with the label inferred for unlabelled bars (Kingma et al. 2014, M2).
semi_supervised_vae.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the M2 classifier q(up | row); training adds the labelled bound and the label-marginalised unlabelled bound of a variational autoencoder. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. The price model is M1 plus a regression head on the latent mean. Expect: reconstruction dominates; the classifier weight matters.

semi_supervised_gan.summary: A discriminator that tells up, down and generated bars apart, with a generator trained to match real bars' features (Salimans et al. 2016).
semi_supervised_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the softmax over the discriminator's two class logits (the fake class implicit); unlabelled bars and generator samples train its real / fake term. Differs from the spec: Labels are masked in embargoed blocks so there is an unlabelled pool. That deliberately handicaps the model against full supervision. Generated rows are feature rows; no price model. Expect: unstable; it stops on validation log loss, not the adversarial loss.
